description: Same questions for the single ReAct agent and the specialist team. Quality is the fraction of fact-groups present in the answer.

cases.label: One fact
cases.task: What was the cause of the loss?
cases.why: One specialist against one ReAct loop. The hand-off pastes the question again.

cases.label: Three independent facts
cases.task: Report three things: the cause of the loss, the all-peril deductible, and the net settlement amount.
cases.why: Three independent facts. Specialists can run together. Each still receives the full task.

cases.label: Coverage only
cases.task: Is flood excluded, and what is the water backup endorsement limit?
cases.why: Only coverage matches. The manager should not call the other specialists.

cases.label: Cause, then coverage, then money
cases.task: Investigate this claim. First find the cause of loss. If it is water-related, check whether flood or gradual seepage is excluded and whether a water backup endorsement exists. Then give the contractor repair estimate and the net settlement.
cases.why: Later steps depend on the cause, so the specialists run in order and each still receives the full task.
